title: NBA Finals Game 6, Warriors vs Raptors — Draymond Green corner make ruled a 2, not reviewed; stands (Jun 13, 2019)
incident_summary: Late in the first quarter of Game 6 of the 2019 NBA Finals (approximately 2:15 remaining, per NBC Sports Bay Area), Draymond Green made a corner jump shot that was ruled a 2-pointer on the floor. Replays suggested he may have been behind the arc, but the play was not reviewed. The league's position, as reported by NBC Sports Bay Area, was that even if reviewed there would not have been clear and conclusive evidence to overturn the on-floor ruling of a 2-point field goal. Golden State trailed by 3 at halftime instead of a possible 2; with 9 seconds left in the game the Warriors had the ball down 1 — a span during which the un-awarded point loomed large. The ruling was never changed.
